entities.name: HIV-1 Tat
observations: The 101-aa query has 78.2% identity and 100% coverage to reviewed HIV-1 subtype C Tat UniProt O12161 (E-value 9.54e-55).
Pfam Tat domain PF00539.24 matches query positions 3–63 (i-Evalue 7.1e-34).
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 11.43 kDa, theoretical pI 9.30, GRAVY −1.31, instability index 85.28.
Reviewed Tat annotation describes TAR-dependent transcriptional activation and recruitment of P-TEFb to promote RNA polymerase II elongation; this is homology-based evidence for the query.

source_tools.relevance: Sequence properties, full-length reviewed Tat homology, functional annotation, and Pfam domain evidence.
